title: IF THE LORD WILL
KJV GUIDANCE PRAYER
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: calm mountain lake early morning mist
quiet mountain pass soft morning light
serene pine forest path dawn light
calm river flowing through mountain valley

scenes.a: Look at your plans for tomorrow and quiet your rushing thoughts.
Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life?
It is even a vapor, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
Father, teach us to surrender our schedule and our certainty into Your holy hands today.
